child_tool_info.description: Inspect, trim, pair, map or clean supplied sequencing reads through BV-BRC; return selected native measurements and explicit numerical components.
child_tool_info.instructions:
Inspect or preprocess the supplied sequencing reads through the selected BV-BRC FastqUtils service. Supply original paired_end_libs, single_end_libs or srr_libs arrays, the ordered recipe, output_path and output_file. Preserve library order, repeated recipe entries, original spelling and start parameters. A paired library may omit read2; do not infer a mate. Files and internally named inputs are valid starting material; no candidate function or public gene identifier is required.

The available native recipe steps are TRIM, PAIRED_FILTER, FASTQC, ALIGN and SCRUB_HUMAN. Choose only the operations required for the assigned investigation. TRIM changes the current reads. PAIRED_FILTER partitions paired and singleton reads. FASTQC inspects the current population and may reuse a previously recorded QC result. ALIGN produces an alignment branch and requires reference_genome_id. SCRUB_HUMAN produces a cleaned branch. Neither alignment nor cleaning automatically replaces the current read population in the inspected producer. Submitted recipe order is a request, not proof that each step executed. Multiple libraries and repeated steps require exact original-task and artifact associations; never infer them from a basename.

Commission the existing launch episode with the selected job, constraints and requested typed handoff. Its API child selects api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare to validate supplied parameters and the application definition without submission. Explicit input uploads, submission, status and selected log observations remain separate available primitive operations. Submission uses the exact preparation receipt and preserves the native task. Generic API monitoring instructions apply; native states and logs inform the episode's own next choice. There is no fixed retry, polling schedule or hidden resource substitution.

Commission the existing results episode for that original task. Use actual task_info(job_result_id), Workspace metadata, task manifest, exact manifest members, download capabilities and complete selected bytes as needed. The episode chooses those acquisitions. Select bvbrc_fastqutils version2 with analysis_id, documents, metadata_bindings and calculation_requests. Documents may name an existing output requirement before bytes are downloaded; already possessed inputs use their exact content binding. Multiple distinct matching artifacts are ambiguous. A filename suffix is not a format or completeness guarantee. Preserve missing, malformed, partial and unknown observations separately from measured zero.

Declared native formats include FASTQ/plain or gzip, SAM1.6, BAM1/BGZF, FastQC0.12.1 HTML/data/ZIP, Trim Galore0.6.10 reports with embedded Cutadapt4.9 full reports, fastq-pair0.3 stderr and Hostile1.1.0 JSON. Keep each Cutadapt invocation, mate and adapter occurrence distinct. Cutadapt output may be filtered again by Trim Galore; its output count does not establish the final FASTQ count. Adapter-removal events can exceed unique reads. Preserve histogram lengths and error bins, native chance estimates and rounded percentages with their meanings. A reported producer version and the actual grammar are separate evidence; a matching parser cannot establish a deployed version. FastQC graph images cannot supply missing numerical tables. Native smoothed distributions and scaled kmer counts retain those meanings. A BAI index supplies no read denominator. Unsupported SAMstat, other Cutadapt versions and SRA metadata formats remain retained artifacts with explicit parser requirements until their formats are implemented.

The sheet retains read and base counts, symbols, lengths, quality histograms, alignment records, native report quantities, populations and exact supplied metadata. Composition uses explicit denominators. Quality-model expected errors require a full histogram and either format-defined SAM/BAM quality or an explicit source-bound FASTQ encoding assumption. Keep that assumption with the result; do not replace it with FastQC's inferred encoding label. Mapping fractions require the complete input-read denominator and unambiguous actual read-segment correspondence. A mapped-only BAM cannot supply the total input population. Retention requires compatible before/after counts and a native report relationship or an explicitly recorded lineage assumption. Such an assumption permits conditional arithmetic but never proves recipe completion. Multiple Hostile reports may have overwritten one another in the producer; the final report cannot represent every library.

Select the numerical components and return fields needed for the assigned question. Deterministic calculators use the saved sheet and explicit parameters without acquiring data or rerunning software. Individual operands, units, numerator, denominator and assumptions remain inspectable. Read counts, Phred-model errors, retention and mapping fractions are not annotation probabilities. Request measurement, component, category, population, association, requirements or request_status facts through the original typed parent form. one_target preserves missing slots; exact_rows retains all actual matches and reports excess cardinality. available_value and typed_state have different missing-value requirements. Only requested facts cross the boundary; full native bytes and sheets remain stored. Parsing, calculation and forwarding add no completed action or credit. This API binding does not establish current service deployment or local/HPC execution.

evidence_axis.investigation_instructions:
Determine what functions the supplied gene or protein may perform by comparing its sequence with relevant homologs and family profiles. Start from the supplied sequence, selected file record or region, or snippets. No candidate annotation or searchable public name is required. Preserve the selected material and its boundaries; do not infer a complete sequence from snippets or choose an arbitrary record from a multi-record file.

Use the comparisons to identify plausible families and distinguish their functions. Examine what was experimentally characterized in relevant homologs, including close relatives with different functions, and map the features bearing on those differences to the supplied target. Retain the identity of the experimentally studied subject separately from the sequence or profile used in a search. A database description or inherited family label is not experimental characterization.

Retain actual alignment or profile scores, bit scores, E-values, identity, matched spans and coverage when available, with the method, search space, score units, denominators and reported uncertainty or bounds. Keep query and comparator coverage distinct, and distinguish a matched domain from the whole protein. Compare numbers only where their methods and scales permit the comparison; a sequence score is not a probability of a particular function.

Examine catalytic and recognition residues, missing or additional domains, and substitutions or insertions that distinguish possible activities. High overall identity can coexist with different substrate specificity; a short match or conserved cofactor-binding region can support only a broader conclusion. Preserve negative results, function-changing differences and unresolved regions. Revise the possible functions as the comparisons become informative, keeping family membership, exact reaction, substrate specificity and physiological role distinct.
evidence_axis.name: Sequence homology

thought_pattern.boundary: Choose a comparator for transfer of a disputed biological property. P02 instead tests an explicit feature-to-function implication against discordant cases. A better sequence score, fold match or neighborhood is a tool result, not the transfer conclusion.
decision_guidance: Prefer references that separate plausible alternatives, not simply the most familiar name or highest global score. Alignments, structures and context searches are ways to inspect a chosen relationship.
When a comparison is weak, consider a biologically better reference before treating it as evidence against all relationship.
Keep catalytic compatibility, target recognition and native role as separate transfer claims; absent catalytic machinery can overturn an inherited chemistry.
thought_pattern.description: Use similarity to a characterized system to form bounded explanations. Choose which sequence, local structural machinery, domain architecture, genomic context or organismal circumstance makes the reference informative for the disputed property; revise misleading comparators.
live_alternatives: A relevant shared relationship supports transfer of the disputed property.
Only a partial core is shared; recognition, partners or role differ.
The comparator or short match is uninformative for this question.
thought_pattern.name: Choose a relevant analogue and bound what transfers

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Relevant machinery corresponds but specificity differs
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain the supported relationship and investigate the differing recognition or contextual features.
Reopen chemistry and preserve only the relationship actually supported.
Keep function unresolved; absence of an informative match is not absence of function.

thought_pattern.use_when: A nearest hit, fold, motif or similar biological context suggests an annotation, but exact chemistry, recognition or role remains open.

child_tool_info.description: Inspect, trim, pair, map or clean supplied sequencing reads through BV-BRC; return selected native measurements and explicit numerical components.
child_tool_info.instructions:
Inspect or preprocess the supplied sequencing reads through the selected BV-BRC FastqUtils service. Supply original paired_end_libs, single_end_libs or srr_libs arrays, the ordered recipe, output_path and output_file. Preserve library order, repeated recipe entries, original spelling and start parameters. A paired library may omit read2; do not infer a mate. Files and internally named inputs are valid starting material; no candidate function or public gene identifier is required.

The available native recipe steps are TRIM, PAIRED_FILTER, FASTQC, ALIGN and SCRUB_HUMAN. Choose only the operations required for the assigned investigation. TRIM changes the current reads. PAIRED_FILTER partitions paired and singleton reads. FASTQC inspects the current population and may reuse a previously recorded QC result. ALIGN produces an alignment branch and requires reference_genome_id. SCRUB_HUMAN produces a cleaned branch. Neither alignment nor cleaning automatically replaces the current read population in the inspected producer. Submitted recipe order is a request, not proof that each step executed. Multiple libraries and repeated steps require exact original-task and artifact associations; never infer them from a basename.

Commission the existing launch episode with the selected job, constraints and requested typed handoff. Its API child selects api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare to validate supplied parameters and the application definition without submission. Explicit input uploads, submission, status and selected log observations remain separate available primitive operations. Submission uses the exact preparation receipt and preserves the native task. Generic API monitoring instructions apply; native states and logs inform the episode's own next choice. There is no fixed retry, polling schedule or hidden resource substitution.

Commission the existing results episode for that original task. Use actual task_info(job_result_id), Workspace metadata, task manifest, exact manifest members, download capabilities and complete selected bytes as needed. The episode chooses those acquisitions. Select bvbrc_fastqutils version2 with analysis_id, documents, metadata_bindings and calculation_requests. Documents may name an existing output requirement before bytes are downloaded; already possessed inputs use their exact content binding. Multiple distinct matching artifacts are ambiguous. A filename suffix is not a format or completeness guarantee. Preserve missing, malformed, partial and unknown observations separately from measured zero.

Declared native formats include FASTQ/plain or gzip, SAM1.6, BAM1/BGZF, FastQC0.12.1 HTML/data/ZIP, Trim Galore0.6.10 reports with embedded Cutadapt4.9 full reports, fastq-pair0.3 stderr and Hostile1.1.0 JSON. Keep each Cutadapt invocation, mate and adapter occurrence distinct. Cutadapt output may be filtered again by Trim Galore; its output count does not establish the final FASTQ count. Adapter-removal events can exceed unique reads. Preserve histogram lengths and error bins, native chance estimates and rounded percentages with their meanings. A reported producer version and the actual grammar are separate evidence; a matching parser cannot establish a deployed version. FastQC graph images cannot supply missing numerical tables. Native smoothed distributions and scaled kmer counts retain those meanings. A BAI index supplies no read denominator. Unsupported SAMstat, other Cutadapt versions and SRA metadata formats remain retained artifacts with explicit parser requirements until their formats are implemented.

The sheet retains read and base counts, symbols, lengths, quality histograms, alignment records, native report quantities, populations and exact supplied metadata. Composition uses explicit denominators. Quality-model expected errors require a full histogram and either format-defined SAM/BAM quality or an explicit source-bound FASTQ encoding assumption. Keep that assumption with the result; do not replace it with FastQC's inferred encoding label. Mapping fractions require the complete input-read denominator and unambiguous actual read-segment correspondence. A mapped-only BAM cannot supply the total input population. Retention requires compatible before/after counts and a native report relationship or an explicitly recorded lineage assumption. Such an assumption permits conditional arithmetic but never proves recipe completion. Multiple Hostile reports may have overwritten one another in the producer; the final report cannot represent every library.

Select the numerical components and return fields needed for the assigned question. Deterministic calculators use the saved sheet and explicit parameters without acquiring data or rerunning software. Individual operands, units, numerator, denominator and assumptions remain inspectable. Read counts, Phred-model errors, retention and mapping fractions are not annotation probabilities. Request measurement, component, category, population, association, requirements or request_status facts through the original typed parent form. one_target preserves missing slots; exact_rows retains all actual matches and reports excess cardinality. available_value and typed_state have different missing-value requirements. Only requested facts cross the boundary; full native bytes and sheets remain stored. Parsing, calculation and forwarding add no completed action or credit. This API binding does not establish current service deployment or local/HPC execution.
child_tool_info.name: bvbrc.fastqutils

evidence_axis.investigation_instructions:
Determine what functions the supplied gene or protein may perform by comparing its sequence with relevant homologs and family profiles. Start from the supplied sequence, selected file record or region, or snippets. No candidate annotation or searchable public name is required. Preserve the selected material and its boundaries; do not infer a complete sequence from snippets or choose an arbitrary record from a multi-record file.

Use the comparisons to identify plausible families and distinguish their functions. Examine what was experimentally characterized in relevant homologs, including close relatives with different functions, and map the features bearing on those differences to the supplied target. Retain the identity of the experimentally studied subject separately from the sequence or profile used in a search. A database description or inherited family label is not experimental characterization.

Retain actual alignment or profile scores, bit scores, E-values, identity, matched spans and coverage when available, with the method, search space, score units, denominators and reported uncertainty or bounds. Keep query and comparator coverage distinct, and distinguish a matched domain from the whole protein. Compare numbers only where their methods and scales permit the comparison; a sequence score is not a probability of a particular function.

Examine catalytic and recognition residues, missing or additional domains, and substitutions or insertions that distinguish possible activities. High overall identity can coexist with different substrate specificity; a short match or conserved cofactor-binding region can support only a broader conclusion. Preserve negative results, function-changing differences and unresolved regions. Revise the possible functions as the comparisons become informative, keeping family membership, exact reaction, substrate specificity and physiological role distinct.
evidence_axis.name: Sequence homology

thought_pattern.boundary: Choose a comparator for transfer of a disputed biological property. P02 instead tests an explicit feature-to-function implication against discordant cases. A better sequence score, fold match or neighborhood is a tool result, not the transfer conclusion.
decision_guidance: Prefer references that separate plausible alternatives, not simply the most familiar name or highest global score. Alignments, structures and context searches are ways to inspect a chosen relationship.
When a comparison is weak, consider a biologically better reference before treating it as evidence against all relationship.
Keep catalytic compatibility, target recognition and native role as separate transfer claims; absent catalytic machinery can overturn an inherited chemistry.
thought_pattern.description: Use similarity to a characterized system to form bounded explanations. Choose which sequence, local structural machinery, domain architecture, genomic context or organismal circumstance makes the reference informative for the disputed property; revise misleading comparators.
live_alternatives: A relevant shared relationship supports transfer of the disputed property.
Only a partial core is shared; recognition, partners or role differ.
The comparator or short match is uninformative for this question.
thought_pattern.name: Choose a relevant analogue and bound what transfers

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Relevant machinery corresponds but specificity differs
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain the supported relationship and investigate the differing recognition or contextual features.
Reopen chemistry and preserve only the relationship actually supported.
Keep function unresolved; absence of an informative match is not absence of function.

thought_pattern.use_when: A nearest hit, fold, motif or similar biological context suggests an annotation, but exact chemistry, recognition or role remains open.

child_tool_info.description: Inspect, trim, pair, map or clean supplied sequencing reads through BV-BRC; return selected native measurements and explicit numerical components.
child_tool_info.instructions:
Inspect or preprocess the supplied sequencing reads through the selected BV-BRC FastqUtils service. Supply original paired_end_libs, single_end_libs or srr_libs arrays, the ordered recipe, output_path and output_file. Preserve library order, repeated recipe entries, original spelling and start parameters. A paired library may omit read2; do not infer a mate. Files and internally named inputs are valid starting material; no candidate function or public gene identifier is required.

The available native recipe steps are TRIM, PAIRED_FILTER, FASTQC, ALIGN and SCRUB_HUMAN. Choose only the operations required for the assigned investigation. TRIM changes the current reads. PAIRED_FILTER partitions paired and singleton reads. FASTQC inspects the current population and may reuse a previously recorded QC result. ALIGN produces an alignment branch and requires reference_genome_id. SCRUB_HUMAN produces a cleaned branch. Neither alignment nor cleaning automatically replaces the current read population in the inspected producer. Submitted recipe order is a request, not proof that each step executed. Multiple libraries and repeated steps require exact original-task and artifact associations; never infer them from a basename.

Commission the existing launch episode with the selected job, constraints and requested typed handoff. Its API child selects api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare to validate supplied parameters and the application definition without submission. Explicit input uploads, submission, status and selected log observations remain separate available primitive operations. Submission uses the exact preparation receipt and preserves the native task. Generic API monitoring instructions apply; native states and logs inform the episode's own next choice. There is no fixed retry, polling schedule or hidden resource substitution.

Commission the existing results episode for that original task. Use actual task_info(job_result_id), Workspace metadata, task manifest, exact manifest members, download capabilities and complete selected bytes as needed. The episode chooses those acquisitions. Select bvbrc_fastqutils version2 with analysis_id, documents, metadata_bindings and calculation_requests. Documents may name an existing output requirement before bytes are downloaded; already possessed inputs use their exact content binding. Multiple distinct matching artifacts are ambiguous. A filename suffix is not a format or completeness guarantee. Preserve missing, malformed, partial and unknown observations separately from measured zero.

Declared native formats include FASTQ/plain or gzip, SAM1.6, BAM1/BGZF, FastQC0.12.1 HTML/data/ZIP, Trim Galore0.6.10 reports with embedded Cutadapt4.9 full reports, fastq-pair0.3 stderr and Hostile1.1.0 JSON. Keep each Cutadapt invocation, mate and adapter occurrence distinct. Cutadapt output may be filtered again by Trim Galore; its output count does not establish the final FASTQ count. Adapter-removal events can exceed unique reads. Preserve histogram lengths and error bins, native chance estimates and rounded percentages with their meanings. A reported producer version and the actual grammar are separate evidence; a matching parser cannot establish a deployed version. FastQC graph images cannot supply missing numerical tables. Native smoothed distributions and scaled kmer counts retain those meanings. A BAI index supplies no read denominator. Unsupported SAMstat, other Cutadapt versions and SRA metadata formats remain retained artifacts with explicit parser requirements until their formats are implemented.

The sheet retains read and base counts, symbols, lengths, quality histograms, alignment records, native report quantities, populations and exact supplied metadata. Composition uses explicit denominators. Quality-model expected errors require a full histogram and either format-defined SAM/BAM quality or an explicit source-bound FASTQ encoding assumption. Keep that assumption with the result; do not replace it with FastQC's inferred encoding label. Mapping fractions require the complete input-read denominator and unambiguous actual read-segment correspondence. A mapped-only BAM cannot supply the total input population. Retention requires compatible before/after counts and a native report relationship or an explicitly recorded lineage assumption. Such an assumption permits conditional arithmetic but never proves recipe completion. Multiple Hostile reports may have overwritten one another in the producer; the final report cannot represent every library.

Select the numerical components and return fields needed for the assigned question. Deterministic calculators use the saved sheet and explicit parameters without acquiring data or rerunning software. Individual operands, units, numerator, denominator and assumptions remain inspectable. Read counts, Phred-model errors, retention and mapping fractions are not annotation probabilities. Request measurement, component, category, population, association, requirements or request_status facts through the original typed parent form. one_target preserves missing slots; exact_rows retains all actual matches and reports excess cardinality. available_value and typed_state have different missing-value requirements. Only requested facts cross the boundary; full native bytes and sheets remain stored. Parsing, calculation and forwarding add no completed action or credit. This API binding does not establish current service deployment or local/HPC execution.
child_tool_info.name: bvbrc.fastqutils

evidence_axis.investigation_instructions:
Determine what functions the supplied gene or protein may perform by comparing its sequence with relevant homologs and family profiles. Start from the supplied sequence, selected file record or region, or snippets. No candidate annotation or searchable public name is required. Preserve the selected material and its boundaries; do not infer a complete sequence from snippets or choose an arbitrary record from a multi-record file.

Use the comparisons to identify plausible families and distinguish their functions. Examine what was experimentally characterized in relevant homologs, including close relatives with different functions, and map the features bearing on those differences to the supplied target. Retain the identity of the experimentally studied subject separately from the sequence or profile used in a search. A database description or inherited family label is not experimental characterization.

Retain actual alignment or profile scores, bit scores, E-values, identity, matched spans and coverage when available, with the method, search space, score units, denominators and reported uncertainty or bounds. Keep query and comparator coverage distinct, and distinguish a matched domain from the whole protein. Compare numbers only where their methods and scales permit the comparison; a sequence score is not a probability of a particular function.

Examine catalytic and recognition residues, missing or additional domains, and substitutions or insertions that distinguish possible activities. High overall identity can coexist with different substrate specificity; a short match or conserved cofactor-binding region can support only a broader conclusion. Preserve negative results, function-changing differences and unresolved regions. Revise the possible functions as the comparisons become informative, keeping family membership, exact reaction, substrate specificity and physiological role distinct.
evidence_axis.name: Sequence homology

thought_pattern.boundary: Choose a comparator for transfer of a disputed biological property. P02 instead tests an explicit feature-to-function implication against discordant cases. A better sequence score, fold match or neighborhood is a tool result, not the transfer conclusion.
decision_guidance: Prefer references that separate plausible alternatives, not simply the most familiar name or highest global score. Alignments, structures and context searches are ways to inspect a chosen relationship.
When a comparison is weak, consider a biologically better reference before treating it as evidence against all relationship.
Keep catalytic compatibility, target recognition and native role as separate transfer claims; absent catalytic machinery can overturn an inherited chemistry.
thought_pattern.description: Use similarity to a characterized system to form bounded explanations. Choose which sequence, local structural machinery, domain architecture, genomic context or organismal circumstance makes the reference informative for the disputed property; revise misleading comparators.
live_alternatives: A relevant shared relationship supports transfer of the disputed property.
Only a partial core is shared; recognition, partners or role differ.
The comparator or short match is uninformative for this question.
thought_pattern.name: Choose a relevant analogue and bound what transfers

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Relevant machinery corresponds but specificity differs
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain the supported relationship and investigate the differing recognition or contextual features.
Reopen chemistry and preserve only the relationship actually supported.
Keep function unresolved; absence of an informative match is not absence of function.

thought_pattern.use_when: A nearest hit, fold, motif or similar biological context suggests an annotation, but exact chemistry, recognition or role remains open.

tools.name: launch.instructions.select

tools.description: Inspect the supported estimate for a proposed wait using your received progress, original duration snapshots and completed own-action history. Unknown event probabilities and gains remain unknown. This tool selects no wait, timer, resource or work.
tools.name: episode.estimate_wait

tools.description: Read only this Episode's prior decisions: metadata index, exact selected actions/outcomes and admitted direct-child forms, or a bounded publication-ID page from one prior own action. Failed outcomes remain failed. This ordinary read never executes old work or reads child-private conversations.

limit.description: Requested page size; defaults to max(1, restoration preview_size), so disabling automatic previews still permits an ordinary page to advance. Omit when selecting decision_indices.

offset.description: Position in this Episode's ordered prior-decision page; omit when selecting decision_indices.

limit.description: Requested publication-ID page size; defaults to max(1, restoration preview_size).

offset.description: Position in the actual saved publication-ID array for this one prior own action.
